value.rationale: A published exhaustive one-step spectrum identifies exactly four proper-image entropy maximizers. Distinguishing their dynamics after an additional step is a natural and useful structural refinement. The examples exhibit the unusual combination of identical complete one-step languages, incomparable second-step languages and strictly ordered second-step entropy. The shorter first-loss horizon occurs for the *larger* second-image entropy, separating first-obstruction timing from asymptotic distinct-output growth. Exact integer eigenvalue certificates allow independent reproduction and further study.
